finding.mechanism: Stale enumeration carried forward from the prior wave: the statement said 'ALL FOUR prior reports' and omitted the fifth historical Checker FINDINGS report (sha256 34d4054a04b3a0720d568c8db086c4ce3aece6203709b6175edd2323b4d1f2b1) that was added in the same commit.
finding.authority_impact: NONE — no false success, no provider invocation, no widened ceiling or exclusion, no executable behaviour change.

what_changed: The stale 'ALL FOUR prior reports' statement was replaced with a FULL, unabbreviated enumeration of all FIVE historical Checker FINDINGS reports, by full sha256.
A review_report_register was added that keeps three report classes strictly distinct: HISTORICAL_FINDINGS_EVIDENCE (five), CLEAN_AUTHORITY_REVIEW (one), SEQUENTIAL_ADVISORY_REVIEW (one).
The historical FINDINGS reports are explicitly marked is_acceptance:false and are NOT called acceptance anywhere.
The correction was applied both in the regenerated wave matrix and at the source artifact, so the defective string does not survive in the repository.
correction.remains_subject_to: INDEPENDENT PACKAGE CHECKER VERIFICATION. This correction is Builder work; it is not self-accepted and it is not package acceptance.
